answer: Make trust an ocean crossing no farm can fake: a newcomer must drift through three separate currents of useful work, each job sealed with a distinct cipher and signed by an unrelated stranger, so its drift log proves real passage, not a printed route. An onyx anchor is minted only after all three currents are crossed, binding standing to one key that cannot be copied or sold. Random tide audits re-check the logs each epoch, freezing any whose ciphers repeat signers. Sybil farms must fund an anchor, drift every current, and survive audits for each clone, costing more than honest work pays.
